takeaways: Azure Bastion is a fully managed service that gives secure RDP and SSH access to Azure VMs over HTTPS, so the VMs need no public IP and no exposed management ports.
Native Entra ID authentication brings MFA, Conditional Access and Azure RBAC roles to VM logins and removes the need for local accounts and passwords on each machine.
Choose the Standard or Premium SKU for production, deploy into a dedicated AzureBastionSubnet, remove public IPs and restrict NSGs to the Bastion subnet, starting with your most critical VMs.
hook: Every VM with a public IP and an open RDP port is a target, and jump boxes add their own patching burden. This episode explains Azure Bastion for Azure admins and cloud architects: how it works, what the Entra ID integration adds and which SKU fits your budget. You will know how to remove public IPs and move to identity-based VM access.
